dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a researcher at the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Yes, I am a researcher from the Kshahrewar Darshan. They call me "Speedwalker Dzenana."

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: They probably just say it to tease me, but I'm not gonna lie, I kind of like that nickname.

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Of course, being a researcher means I have to get out and broaden my horizons. I decided to visit Nasha Town this time because I heard there are all kinds of new and interesting mechanisms there!

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: But... I got lost and ended up here instead. Ha, it's just like my mentor said: "Dzenana, make sure you know which way you're going before you set out next time!"
